summary: Script (aggregate.sh) is excellent: proper set -euo pipefail, error handling, quoting throughout. Workflow uses pinned actions (v4) and least-privilege permissions correctly. BUT critical gaps: (1) Workflow missing test fixtures run1.xml/run2.json — are non-existent files assumed to exist; verify job has hardcoded expected values with no way to generate/validate them. (2) Task required bats test suite + act integration + act-result.txt artifact; none delivered. (3) Code duplication: flaky detection (lines 50–75 in summary, ~22 in totals) is identical and should factor into a shared awk function. (4) Workflow doesn't validate script (no shellcheck or bash -n step). (5) Task requirements explicitly stated "ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT" and "test harness must set up repos + run act push + save to act-result.txt"; deliverable has zero test infrastructure.
